rationale: iter-32: weight_decay 1e-4 -> 0 on the iter-28 alpha-scaling residual-in-residual baseline. Headroom 0.5833 -> 0.5906 (+0.73pp, FIRST TIME ANY AGENT EXCEEDS 0.59). val_rmse 0.005503 -> 0.005407 (-1.7%). Hypothesis confirmed: AdamW WD was decaying the learnable per-block alpha scalars (init 0.1), pulling them back toward 0 and preventing them from growing into their useful range. WD=0 lets alpha discover its right magnitude. This compounds with iter-28 to give the new team-wide best. NEW OVERALL BEST (was spawn-B iter-14 at hr=0.587).
advice_for_others: When you add learnable per-parameter scalars (alpha, beta, ReZero, EDSR scaling, etc.) to a small denoiser, disable global weight_decay or exclude those params from WD. The default AdamW WD silently over-regularises the new small-magnitude params and undoes the architectural change.
